title: Ory Kratos LoopZero wrapper values schema
description: Plan v1.2 T2.5 / D4 — fail-fast on missing keys per ADR. Schema enforces uiBaseUrl pattern (no trailing slash per EC-8) and required-by-env override discipline.

uiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for Kratos UI redirects (login, registration, etc.). No trailing slash (EC-8). Per env: dev/standalone/standalone-multi=http://localhost:4455; drill=https://app.loopzero-drill.example; prod=https://app.loopzero.example. Set via infra/helmfile/environments/<env>.yaml.

kratos.description: Upstream ory/kratos chart values pass-through. Schema does not constrain (delegates to upstream chart's own schema).
